title: Perfect In-Sink Farmhouse Drain
text: Perfect In-Sink Farmhouse Drain. This drainer fits perfectly in my sink and though it's small there is plenty of room for dinner plates, glasses, silverware and other dishes.  It's red color adds a nice touch to farmhouse decor!!
